theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_mv_affine_comp_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (x : Euclid n) (s : ℝ) (y a b : Euclid n), fderiv ℝ (fun z : Euclid n => h (x - s • z)) y a = -(s * fderiv ℝ h (x - s • y) a) ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun z : Euclid n => h (x - s • z)) y ![a, b] = s ^ 2 * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h (x - s • y) ![a, b]
